title: Beautiful Kerala Trip
shortDescription: For all its slow rhythm, Kerala is even slower; that is the best thing about Kerala's coastline.
description: For all its slow rhythm, Kerala is even slower; that is the best thing about Kerala's coastline. A beautiful connection between the laid-back feel of Cherai and the cultural fruitiness of Cochin, this short escape provides a refreshing blend of beach time, heritage walks, local art and backwater escapades for you. Peaceful sunsets by the Arabian Sea and bustling corners of the city, richly steeped in history and traditions, all take place at a leisurely pace.

Chinese fishing nets swing along the shore; former colonial points of interest and fine art museums give Kerala soul and body through Kathakali. This route combines sea bracing with cultural richness for couples, families and those who just want to enjoy some calm without racing, because you're not going anywhere at all! It's not a trip that you forget long after you've left.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cochin – Transfer to Cherai
itinerary.description: Arrive in Cochin and meet our representative for a comfortable transfer to Cherai Beach. Spend the day relaxing along the scenic coastline known for its calm surroundings, lagoons, seafood spots, and peaceful atmosphere. Enjoy the beautiful sunset views at Cherai Beach and unwind amidst the soothing seaside ambience.

itinerary.title: Cherai Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a leisurely excursion around Cherai. Explore the long shoreline of Cherai Beach, known for its coconut-lined landscape, serene backwaters, and occasional dolphin sightings. Relax by the beach resort and spend your free time enjoying the coastal surroundings and peaceful beach atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Cherai to Cochin
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Cochin and explore the city’s cultural and heritage attractions. Visit the iconic Chinese Fishing Nets, followed by the historic Paradesi Synagogue, one of the oldest active synagogues in the Commonwealth. Continue to the fascinating Kerala Folklore Museum, showcasing Kerala’s traditional art, architecture, and antiques. Experience the modern side of the city with a ride or visit to the Kochi Water Metro. Later, witness Kerala’s classical storytelling traditions at the K V Kathakali Centre.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cochin
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Cochin Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.
